title: Sharp Hausdorff Dimension Bounds for Sets with Bounded and Growing Digits in $N$-expansions
summary: We establish sharp bounds for the Hausdorff dimension of sets of irrational numbers in $(0,1)$ whose digits in the $N$-expansion are either uniformly bounded or tend to infinity. For sets with digits bounded by an integer $M \ge N$, we obtain improved Jarník-type bounds that generalize and refine classical results for regular continued fractions, with explicit dependence on $N$ (Theorem~1.1).
